content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question regarding the compatibility of a [product_name] CPU module and an expansion module. Here are the details: 1. [product_name], logic module, display PS/I/O: 115V/230V/relay, 8 DI/4 DQ, memory 400 blocks, modular expandable, Ethernet, integrated web server, data log, user-defined web pages, standard microSD card for [product_name] [product_name] [version_no] or higher [article_no] 2. [product_name] expansion module, PS/I/O: 230V/230V/relay, 2 MW, 4 DI/4 DO for [product_name] [version_no] [article_no] I already own the [product_name] logic module ([article_no]). When I check in the official selection tool, [article_no] automatically changes to another article number, so I am unable to verify compatibility between these two modules directly.

Hello [user_name], I could add both modules in the selection tool without any issues, so there shouldn't be a compatibility problem in principle. I added the expansion module first and then the CPU logic module. You might want to try arranging them this way to see if the tool allows it.

Expansion modules with [article_no] at the end of the article number are compatible with all [version_no] CPUs. Expansion modules with [article_no] or [article_no] at the end of the article number are not compatible with all [version_no] CPUs. analysis.insight_summary: Community members are discussing compatibility between different [product_name] modules, each identified by specific article numbers. Users experience issues confirming compatibility using the official selection tool, as article numbers get automatically substituted and direct comparison becomes unclear. As a result, users seek advice and clarification from peers rather than relying solely on the online configurator.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for straightforward, tool-supported verification of compatibility for particular [product_name] modules by article number. They expect an easy mapping between module versions in the tool, without automatic replacements or ambiguity from the provider's official configurator.
